That is the same build/validate gap #28643 (PR #28681) closed for the override-declaration judge, which emptied `VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES`.

## Wanted

1. `packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts` calls the one `__c` judge #28564 exports (`findExtensionFieldSuffixRefusals` through `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`), at the same early position #28681 used, ahead of every artifact write, with the same refusal text and a non-zero exit.
2. Move the judge's row in `packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts` from `VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES` to the shared set.
3. Tests: `os build` refuses case (a) and case (b) with nothing written; a `.custom` extension field `region__c` builds. One ablation.
